bullets.text: One hundred fifty families in Velachery continue living in unsafe housing despite court warnings, and the office should monitor this risk.
Passengers expressed deep concern over the poor condition of the Chennai MRTS project at Adambakkam station, requiring office attention.
TCS subsidiary HyperVault plans a seventy thousand crore rupees AI data centre campus in Hyderabad, and the department should watch this regional growth.
India data centre capacity grew five times in a decade to reach one point six gigawatts, reflecting strong national infrastructure momentum.
Investors are backing Indian power and component suppliers to ride the AI boom, showing how supply chains support the broader technology surge.
